subject.title: Session hangs indefinitely when compaction times out, causing repeated duplicate message sends

question: Should #43661 remain a concrete P0 Telegram recovery satellite under #101863, or should maintainers designate a narrower canonical Telegram replay/recovery issue for the remaining work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix shape depends on maintainer direction across run lifecycle ownership, channel reconciliation contracts, and non-technical recovery UX.

options.title: Keep as P0 satellite
options.body: Keep this issue open and linked to #101863 until the lifecycle umbrella lands with Telegram-specific proof and recovery UX evidence.

options.title: Split Telegram canonical
options.body: Create or designate a narrower canonical issue for Telegram ambiguous-send reconciliation and poisoned-session recovery, then close this as superseded once the narrower item has the full scope.

options.title: Fold entirely into lifecycle umbrella
options.body: Close this only if maintainers decide #101863 will explicitly own the Telegram duplicate-send and recovery proof requirements.

recommendation.title: Keep as P0 satellite
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and linked to #101863 until the lifecycle umbrella lands with Telegram-specific proof and recovery UX evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus owns the related lifecycle umbrella that appears to decide the cross-surface run recovery direction.
